title: console: a list view whose query is refused with 400 INVALID_FIELD names the column's field, so an operator can tell which column to fix (follow-up of #31866)
body:
domain:server#3 · os-steve · session_01ADHkmQXLfvyB5R53VDm3Ka

Filing gate: ④ coordination node: item 3 of #31866 (cloud#4074's finding), which the card left as a lane call. The server half lands in PR #31892: the `/meta` read of a list view now carries a `list-view-field-unknown` warning in `_diagnostics.warnings`. ⛔ Not a claim.
Business reason: when a list view's column names a field its object lacks, the data read answers `400 INVALID_FIELD` and the console shows "This view's query was rejected" with no rows and no field named (cloud#4074: `ai_traces` column `cost_total`, field `total_cost`). An operator cannot tell which column to fix without opening developer tools.
Reader: the `domain:ui` seat.
Dedupe (open AND closed): `query was rejected INVALID_FIELD list view console field` → #31866 only (the server half), not on point.
class: c · type: Bug
Refs #31866

## 维护者速读

列表视图的某一列引用了不存在的字段时，打开列表只显示「该视图的查询被拒绝」，不说是哪一列。这张卡让控制台把 400 里的字段名显示出来。

## What to build

- In the console's list view, the refused-query state reads the field the `400 INVALID_FIELD` answer names and shows it, with the column it came from where the view maps it, in plain wording ("Column `cost_total` names a field this object does not have").
- If the view's `/meta` read carries a `list-view-field-unknown` warning (#31866), the state can name it from there too. Prefer the 400's own field when both are present.
- Pins: the `cost_total` reproduction shows the field name; any other 400 keeps today's state (CONTROL).
- Clause-②: no. Metadata-protocol: none. ui only.
